title: Senior Engineering Manager - Fintech
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the department

Cloudflare’s Fintech Engineering Team is at the heart of every product launch, campaign, and initiative that Cloudflare undertakes. We build and maintain critical systems for billing, payments, usage metering, aggregation, invoicing and revenue recognition — powering billions in revenue and serving millions of customers.

Currently we're rebuilding our entire billing platform, designing a metering and aggregation layer that scales effortlessly while ensuring financial accuracy. This is high-impact, high-stakes work that touches all Cloudflare’s cutting-edge products like AI, Zero Trust, Edge Compute, Bot Management, DDoS Protection, etc.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a team of talented, collaborative engineers working across Cloudflare’s ecosystem. You’ll navigate multiple high-profile projects, foster a culture of proactive communication and continuous learning, and drive technical excellence.

If you thrive on solving hard challenges at the intersection of financial infrastructure and distributed systems, this is your opportunity to make a massive impact while growing with us.

What you'll do You will lead a team of talented engineers responsible for building and maintaining Cloudflare’s billing and payments infrastructure. You will oversee the development of scalable, high-reliability financial infrastructure that handles everything related to Cloudflare’s revenue. Your work will directly support billions in revenue and millions of customers while enabling new product launches across Cloudflare.

You will play a key role in rebuilding our entire billing platform, designing a next-generation financial infrastructure that ensures financial accuracy and seamless performance. Leading a team of skilled engineers, you will drive the execution of complex technical initiatives, ensuring our architecture is resilient, scalable, and future-proof.

Beyond technical execution, you will focus on growing and mentoring a high-performing engineering team. You will set clear expectations, provide thoughtful feedback, and create an environment where engineers can thrive. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, finance, data science, operations and support departments to align technical decisions with business objectives. Your ability to communicate effectively, manage priorities, and navigate a fast-paced environment will be critical in driving success.

This role is an opportunity to make a lasting impact at the intersection of financial infrastructure and distributed systems. You will help shape the future of Cloudflare, ensuring it can support the company’s rapid growth and evolving product ecosystem.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • Experience leading a team or multiple teams of senior and staff engineers.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, driving alignment, and clearly creating and communicating technical direction for large cross-company efforts.
  • Comfortable leading and hiring a team that builds the backend systems and frontend parts of the product.
  • Excel at planning, creating teams and overseeing execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability.
  • Comfortable building developer-loved APIs that scale.
  • Demonstrate a track record of leading a team including hiring, on-boarding, and professional development.
  • You inspire your team to reach higher.
  • You’re as good as explaining “why” as you are “how”.
  • Experience implementing tools, process, internal instrumentation, methodologies and resolving blockages.
  • Comfortable managing teams/projections with tight deadlines and short release cycles.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building massive distributed systems.
  • Experience leading teams working on areas of financial infrastructure, payments, billing, and data infrastructure.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Head of Sourcing Enablement & Delivery
description:
About the Team

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement helps OpenAI secure the products, services, and partnerships that support our research, build our products, and grow our business. We work with teams across the company to make sound commercial decisions and move important work forward.

As OpenAI grows, we are rethinking how sourcing works: bringing expertise into decisions earlier, simplifying contracting, and using AI to give Procurement more time for judgment and strategic work. What we learn internally—and through our supplier and enterprise-buyer relationships—can also inform better products, partnerships, and industry adoption.

About the Role

We’re looking for a senior leader to head Sourcing Enablement & Delivery, leading sourcing operational delivery, contracting enablement, and AI transformation—and building Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI’s commercial growth. You will build the teams, systems, service model, and cross-functional partnerships that enable sourcing and contracting at scale, helping teams move quickly without losing commercial discipline or accountability.

You will partner with GTM, Sales, and Partnerships to develop Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth. Bring procurement-industry knowledge, buyer insights, and lessons from internal AI use into customer engagement, product feedback, and opportunities across the procurement ecosystem.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Sourcing, you will manage the Sourcing Delivery and Contract Management leaders and shape this new function’s priorities, team, and measures of success.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Priorities and what success looks like

  • A focused roadmap: clear choices about what to build first, what to defer, and how progress will be measured.

  • Stronger delivery: capable leaders and teams, faster execution, less rework, and fewer unresolved ownership gaps.

  • AI adoption: sustained use of AI-enabled capabilities, with measurable gains in quality, capacity, and user experience.

  • Commercial results: increased OpenAI adoption across the procurement industry and a measurable contribution to commercial growth, consistent with independent supplier selection and purchasing decisions.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and lead the organization. Hire and develop managers, coach performance, and build succession and leadership depth. Decide how employees, contractors, delivery partners, and AI share the work. Hold leaders accountable for results, capacity, and team health.

  • Own sourcing enablement and delivery operations. Set service commitments and quality standards with the Delivery and Contract Management leaders. Match support to deal complexity and risk, and use internal customer feedback to improve the service. Category and Sourcing leads retain ownership of their strategies and deals, including supplier selection, negotiations, and purchasing.

  • Lead the sourcing operating rhythm. Bring demand, priorities, and capacity into one forward plan, informed by workload and performance data. Work with category leaders to make tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and follow through on commitments. Provide inputs to Procurement-wide planning and functional business reviews.

  • Strengthen contracting. Partner with Legal and Procurement Operations/COE on contract lifecycle management, approved templates, and negotiation playbooks that improve quality and free category teams to focus on strategic deals.

  • Lead RACI development. Define responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths within Procurement and across partner teams. Define how the team prioritizes work, allocates resources, and resolves delivery issues.

  • Create mechanisms to bring sourcing into decisions earlier: connect business demand, supplier activity, and renewals—including work outside formal intake—with Sourcing teams, so options can be shaped before commitments and Finance and cross-functional teams can have better visibility.

  • Build and prove AI-enabled ways of working. Own use-case priorities, adoption, and business outcomes for sourcing and contracting experiences that begin in ChatGPT and connect to trusted enterprise systems. Partner with Finance Enterprise Technology on technical delivery and with Legal, Security, and Operations on controls and support, including preserving access restrictions and contractual commitments. Turn what works into reusable capabilities, demonstrations, and product feedback.

  • Define Procurement’s commercial-enablement approach with GTM, Partnerships, Legal, and Compliance including program scope, decision rights, purchasing independence, and information-sharing boundaries. Lead Procurement’s analysis, coordination, and follow-through for approved programs; GTM owns customer sales. Maintain independent purchasing decision-making and identify and escalate any proposed linkage between OpenAI’s purchasing commitments and customer sales.

  • Help define goals and measures of success for Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth with Sourcing leadership and cross-functional partners.

  • Bring procurement-buyer expertise into GTM. Own this team’s buyer insights and use cases. Work with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Partnerships to shape demonstrations, industry content, and customer conversations, using examples approved for external use.

Anthropic is growing quickly, and the transactions we enter into are often unlike anything the accounting literature directly contemplates. We're hiring a senior leader to own accounting policy and technical accounting.

In this role, you will be the company's authority on how we account for what we do: usage-based and enterprise revenue arrangements, large compute and infrastructure transactions, complex financing and equity instruments, and M&A and investment activity. You'll build the technical accounting function from a strong foundation into one that operates at public-company grade — establishing the whitepaper and position-memo discipline that lets us take well-supported positions on novel, first-of-kind transactions, defend them with our external auditors (including their national office), and be ready for public-company-grade reporting when the company needs it.

This is a high-judgment, high-trust role. You'll work closely with the Controller and CFO organization, Legal, Tax, and deal teams across the company, and you'll often be the first accountant in the room when a new kind of transaction is being designed.

  • Own the company's accounting policy framework: establish, document, and maintain US GAAP accounting policies across all significant areas, and keep them current as the business and the standards evolve

  • Advise on equity, financing, and capital-markets transactions, including the accounting for complex instruments and arrangements
  • Lead, and develop a high-caliber technical accounting and accounting policy team as the function scales

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. You will be responsible for identifying and recruiting top talent to your team and engaging with leaders across the organization, including the Legal, Policy, Security, Communications, Support, Product and Engineering teams. You will also represent the company externally with industry peers and government officials, and help identify potential trust and safety related partners and engagements.

Based on the variety of products offered by Cloudflare and the complexity of global legal standards covering requests for information and abuse, the right candidate will have technical expertise, be able to create policies and protocols that account for this complexity, effectively manage a global team responsible for implementing those changing policies, and develop creative solutions that take advantage of Cloudflare’s tools to improve trust and safety functions across the company. You will be expected to solve hard problems under pressure, often with senior executives and internal experts, and clearly communicate your vision to stakeholders across the company.

  • Build, develop, and manage a world-class globally-distributed team that operates 24/7/365.
  • Create and maintain processes and policies for handling legal requests and abuse complaints.
  • Ensure consistent, timely, efficient, and fair application of those policies across a variety of circumstances and locations, incorporating AI-powered automation and processing,
  • Liaise with senior company leaders, attorneys, engineers, and security staff inside Cloudflare to address circumstances that arise with regard to operation of the Trust & Safety team.
  • Work with engineers to create and improve automated tools to drive improvements and increase efficiencies.
  • Partner with the Policy, Legal, and Product teams to develop and implement policies and guidelines that can be enforced in a scalable fashion.
  • Deal with sensitive content and emotionally charged escalations with tact and a calm demeanor.
  • Take responsibility for online fraud and safety concerns, including but not limited to account security, safety concerns and user trust.
  • Represent the company externally with industry groups, government officials, enterprise customers, and members of the press to explain Cloudflare’s approach to Trust and Safety.
  • Maintain and build upon Cloudflare’s transparency reporting process by identifying new areas of interest and information that we should be sharing with the public to maintain trust.

  • Experience working with law enforcement and legal requests for customer information.
  • Deep technical experience understanding how the Internet works.
  • Understanding of the Internet ecosystem and the roles and functions of the various types of online service providers.
  • Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving complex and sensitive issues, often under considerable time pressure. You must have demonstrated the ability to thrive in crisis management.
  • Experience with analytics and experience solving problems using data and providing practical business insights.
  • Experience working closely with c-suite level executives.
  • Significant awareness of existing and emerging approaches to law enforcement access and intermediary liability to be able to engage on such issues at a very high level.
  • A global network of contacts --you can reach the right people quickly to help solve problems that you can’t solve directly.

About the role

As Supabase drives investment into gaming, enterprise, and startup segments, each motion needs co-marketing execution and enablement content to land with AWS field teams and partners. This role owns that work directly: producing the content, case studies, and campaign support tied to AWS co-owned initiatives.

You'll work closely with the segment leads driving each motion and with the Alliances Lead, translating segment strategy into the campaigns and content that actually reach AWS field teams and partners.

What you'll do

  • Produce co-marketing content and enablement assets (case studies, campaign materials, partner-facing documentation) for our gaming, enterprise, startup, and AI segments

  • Plan and execute joint campaigns with AWS field and marketing teams, from initial concept through launch

  • Support AWS-funded marketing engagements and executive-facing events with content and coordination

  • Build and maintain enablement materials that keep our partner-facing teams and AWS contacts current on Supabase's story

  • Identify the right audiences and contacts for campaigns, partnering with RevOps and marketing tooling as needed

Who you are

  • 3-5+ years in partner marketing or co-marketing, ideally with experience working alongside a major cloud provider like AWS or similar strategic partner

  • Strong writer and communicator, able to turn technical products and partnerships into clear, compelling narratives

  • Execution-oriented. This role is about shipping campaigns and content, not managing a mature, fully-staffed program

  • High degree of autonomy and external credibility. You lead your own workstreams, close loops, and represent Supabase in high-stakes partner discussions independently

  • Experience with AWS Partner Central, ACE, and Marketplace mechanisms is a plus

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

About the role

Anthropic's APAC go-to-market organisation is the fastest-growing part of our international business, spanning markets with distinct languages, cultures and buying styles. Today, enablement for the region is delivered by our global and EMEA teams. You will be the first enablement leader on the ground in APAC.

You will change that. As the first enablement leader based in APAC, you will own how the field across the region gets ready: onboarding, ongoing skill development, manager coaching support and launch readiness, for every GTM function, not just sales. You are the multiplier. You turn a rapidly scaling region into a field that is ready for the customer conversations in front of it, in the languages those conversations happen in.

This is a build role with a global spine. You inherit a working global and international enablement engine. Your job is to design for APAC as part of that engine, adapted and translated where it matters, delivered across APAC, feeding what you learn back into the international and global programme. Design, influence and translate, in both directions.

How we work: adults learn by doing, we build sessions around live activity: practice, reflection, real customer scenarios. The measure is not what was covered in the room. It is what changes a week later in how people think, decide and sell.

This takes creativity and a deep understanding of how adults learn, applied at unprecedented speed. The frontier moves quickly and the field is scaling fast. Much of the work is unlearning: helping experienced sellers let go of pre-AI habits, not just teaching new ones. AI is what makes this scalable. description:

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. The world's engineers want to get the most out of Claude. At Anthropic, technical instruction already happens everywhere: our Applied AI and Forward Deployed Engineering teams teach customers and partners, and engineers across the company help others learn to build with Claude. Today that instruction is a shared responsibility, delivered alongside people's primary roles. As demand grows, we need to turn that distributed expertise into a dedicated technical instruction function.

You will build that function.

You will be the first person at Anthropic whose full-time job is technical instruction. You'll spend your first year primarily in the classroom teaching engineers, architects, and other technical practitioners. You'll also build the people, standards, and systems that let Anthropic's technical instruction scale far beyond the people we directly employ.

You're an engineer who teaches and a teacher who has led other teachers. You can build an agent live in front of a skeptical engineer, diagnose what isn't working in a technical lab, and make the material better. You can also watch an experienced instructor teach, tell them their session isn't ready yet, and coach them to get there.

  • Lead from the front. Teach hands-on sessions to new Applied AI engineers, our field teams, and partner cohorts, in rooms from 12-person labs to 100-person training days.

  • Scale through train-the-trainer. Set the bar the Lead Technical Instructor's train-the-trainer program teaches to, for internal experts, contract instructors, and partner facilitators.
  • Turn expertise into instruction. Turn internal experts' content into sessions and labs that work in a live room.
  • Enable programs without owning them. Staff other teams' programs with cleared instructors, and own the quality of instruction inside them.
  • Measure and improve. Report learner pass rates per instructor each month, and act on them.

  • People leadership. You have managed instructors, trainers, developer advocates, or solutions engineers, including hiring and performance management, and kept teaching.
  • Instructor development. You have designed or run a train-the-trainer program, instructor certification, or observation framework.
  • San Francisco location. You are based in San Francisco or willing to relocate with our relocation support, can be in the office every day a program runs, 3 days in a normal week, and can travel 25 to 30 percent.

title: Engineering Manager, Agentic Internet & Data Insights
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal

About the Department

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build products at the intersection of AI, search and retrieval, data insights, and product engineering.

As AI agents change how people discover and interact with the Internet, new problems are emerging around how content is found, understood, retrieved, and kept current. Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to help website owners make their content discoverable and to help agents find relevant, trustworthy information across our network. Building these capabilities requires solving problems across distributed systems, crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval quality, developer experience, and reliable product delivery.

Cloudflare also has a unique perspective on how the Internet is changing. Our global network observes signals that can help us understand trends, identify when content changes, and measure the pulse of the Internet. Used responsibly, these signals could improve existing products, help customers and AI companies find fresher and more relevant information, and create entirely new capabilities and products. The opportunity is broad and still evolving. We need to deliver excellent products today while continuing to identify the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead engineering across some of our AI and Internet Data Insights portfolio.

You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that help customers make their content discoverable and turn complex Internet signals into useful experiences. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.

At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

What you'll do

  • Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across AI-powered search, Internet data insights, and customer-facing products.
  • Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
  • Lead the development of search and retrieval capabilities that help people and AI agents find relevant, trustworthy, and current content.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
  • Help identify how signals from Cloudflare's global network can produce useful and trustworthy insights for customers, partners, and other Cloudflare products.
  • Explore where Cloudflare's unique view of Internet activity can improve content discovery, enable new product experiences, or support entirely new products.
  • Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
  • Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, data and search quality, and long-term reliability.
  • Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

Responsibilities

We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:

  • You have led and developed high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.
  • You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in a distributed system or data platform, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.
  • You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.
  • You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that people use to understand the Internet.
  • You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
  • You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, search systems, data-intensive systems, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas.
  • Experience building or operating products involving crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval, analytics, or large-scale data processing.
  • Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and quality matter as much as feature delivery.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
  • Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which combines information retrieval with generative AI to produce answers grounded in selected source material.
  • Experience building products for AI developers, AI agents, publishers, or content-heavy websites.
  • Experience working with large-scale telemetry or Internet-scale datasets.
  • Experience turning complex underlying systems or data into useful products for a broad audience.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare Radar, Internet measurement research, or the broader ecosystem of tools used to understand Internet performance, availability and security.

Compensation

  • For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €74,000 - €111,000

The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

title: Engineering Manager, Library
description:
About the team

The ChatGPT Library team is building the persistence layer that helps people and organizations collaborate with increasingly capable AI systems. ChatGPT Library provides users with a durable place for their files, context, and creations, forming a substrate between humans and agents—a foundation for AI that can remember, retrieve, and act on the right context over time.

The team sits within the Personalization organization and partners closely with product, design, research, model, and infrastructure teams. Its work helps models become a useful second brain for individuals—for example, answering questions such as “What did I work on last week?”—and supports enterprise use cases that turn company knowledge into accessible, actionable context.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering manager to lead a team of approximately 9–10 engineers and own execution across the product roadmap. This is a technical leadership role for someone who can set a high product bar, build a strong team, shape architecture, and contribute directly when needed. You will form and translate an ambitious product vision into a focused roadmap and help the team ship reliable, intuitive experiences at the intersection of AI, knowledge, and collaboration.

The ideal candidate leads by example. You are comfortable moving between people leadership, product decisions, technical design, and code. Founder or early-stage startup experience is especially valuable because the role requires urgency, sound judgment under ambiguity, and a willingness to operate across boundaries.

In this role you will

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of approximately 9–10 engineers while creating clarity, accountability, and a healthy execution rhythm.

• Own the engineering roadmap for Library, working with product and design partners to prioritize the highest-impact problems.

• Set a high bar for product quality, technical excellence, reliability, privacy, and user trust.

• Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, prototyping, debugging, and coding when it will accelerate the team or unblock a critical path.

• Build systems that allow AI products to persist, retrieve, and use personal and organizational context effectively.

• Partner across Personalization, model, research, infrastructure, enterprise, and third-party integration teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences.

• Navigate ambiguity, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and turn emerging AI capabilities into a clear product and engineering plan.

• Hire exceptional engineers and develop technical leaders who can scale the team’s impact.

You might thrive in this role if you

• Have experience managing and developing high-performing engineering teams while remaining technically hands-on.

• Have a strong software engineering foundation and are comfortable contributing production code in a modern codebase.

• Have built and shipped user-facing products with a high quality bar, ideally in fast-moving or zero-to-one environments.

• Bring founder, startup, or early-stage product experience and know how to create momentum with limited structure.

• Can reason about distributed systems, data persistence, retrieval, permissions, collaboration, and the product implications of AI-native architectures.

• Communicate clearly across engineering, product, design, research, and executive stakeholders.

• Balance long-term technical direction with near-term delivery and know when to simplify, prototype, or invest for scale.

• Care deeply about building AI products that are useful, trustworthy, and intuitive for both individuals and organizations.

title: Head of Finance - Data Centers
description:

As Head of Finance - Data Centers, you will be the finance leader for OpenAI’s self-built data center efforts. You will partner with teams across infrastructure, real estate, energy, construction, procurement, and finance to turn proposed sites into sound investment decisions and funded projects.

This role spans the full development lifecycle: evaluating opportunities, building investment cases, forecasting capital needs, managing construction budgets, and helping determine how projects should be financed. You will give leadership a clear view of project economics, funding requirements, and risks as we build data center capacity at scale.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead financial evaluation of proposed data center and related power infrastructure projects, including site economics, development costs, capacity phasing, lifecycle costs, and key risks.

  • Build and own project-level models and capital expenditure forecasts that connect construction schedules, power delivery, equipment procurement, contingencies, and funding needs.

  • Establish capital budgets and financial controls for active builds. Track commitments, actual spending, change orders, and forecasts to completion; identify cost or schedule risks early.

  • Partner with development, engineering, energy, construction, and procurement leaders on decisions that affect cost, timing, and long-term performance.

  • Build a consistent portfolio view of project costs, cash requirements, milestones, and financial performance. Partner with Accounting and operations teams through project completion and handoff.

  • 10+ years of experience across strategic finance, infrastructure finance, project development, or related fields.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts



Who You Are

You are an experienced digital marketer with a strong foundation in campaign execution, digital marketing operations, and performance optimization. You enjoy translating marketing strategies into well-executed campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

You are highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously. You work collaboratively across Marketing, Product, Creative, Revenue, and Operations teams to execute marketing programs, continuously improve campaign performance, and deliver measurable business results.

You bring strong expertise across digital campaigns, marketing workflows, analytics, SEO, lifecycle marketing, and performance optimization. You are equally comfortable working at the strategic level and getting into the details when needed to ensure high-quality execution.

What You’ll Be Doing

Digital Marketing Strategy & Campaign Ownership

  • Own the execution plan and optimization of integrated multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned with business and marketing objectives.
  • Partner with marketing leadership to plan and implement campaign strategies and execution plans.
  • Support campaign planning by contributing ideas, customer insights, and performance recommendations.
  • Assist in defining campaign objectives, audience targeting, messaging, and execution timelines.

Performance Marketing & Analytics

  • Own campaign performance across key marketing KPIs, including ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, conversion rates, and engagement.
  • Analyze campaign results and identify opportunities to improve performance.
  • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to develop reporting and performance dashboards.
  • Present campaign insights and recommendations to marketing leadership.

Marketing Workflow & Operational Excellence

  • Support the development and continuous improvement of marketing workflows.
  • Identify process improvements that increase campaign efficiency and execution quality.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to improve campaign execution and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Creative, Revenue, Customer Success, Marketing Operations, and Analytics teams to execute integrated marketing initiatives.
  • Lead coordination of cross-functional activities to ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Establish a system and cadence to communicate campaign status, dependencies, and results to key stakeholders.

SEO & Organic Growth

  • Execute SEO initiatives, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO improvements, and performance monitoring.
  • Partner with Content and Web teams to improve organic search visibility.

Customer & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives that improve customer engagement, onboarding, adoption, and retention.
  • Use customer insights and behavioral data to optimize marketing campaigns and customer communications.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current on emerging marketing trends, technologies, and AI capabilities.
  • Recommend new ideas and optimization opportunities that improve campaign performance and customer experience.
  • Share learnings and best practices within the Marketing team.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and executing complex, multi-channel marketing initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Proven track record of improving campaign performance, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention through data-driven optimization.
  • Strong experience with performance marketing, campaign analytics, marketing automation, CRM platforms, and customer journey optimization.
  • Experience developing and executing SEO initiatives, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and organic performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional marketing initiatives by partnering effectively with Marketing, Product, Revenue, Creative, Operations, and Analytics teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced SaaS or technology environment is preferred.
  • Proficiency with digital analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics/GA4), marketing automation tools, CRM systems, and project management platforms.
  • Solid understanding of attribution models, funnel performance, conversion optimization, customer segmentation, and campaign measurement.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and well-supported recommendations.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

description:

We are looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to shape how ChatGPT shows up for students and young adults. This is an opportunity to own the strategy end to end—from how ChatGPT supports student and campus life to how it becomes a creative partner as young people pursue their ambitions.

You will turn a deep understanding of this audience into positioning, experiences, and programs that earn genuine relevance and participation. Your work will span campus communities, student ambassadors, creators, partnerships, activations, social, paid and owned channels, and the product itself.

The right person is an uncommon combination of strategist, operator, and creative thinker. You can uncover and articulate a sharp audience insight, translate it into a compelling plan, bring original ideas to the table, and stand up the work needed to deliver them. You have strong instincts for youth culture, know what will resonate without chasing trends, and can align teams around a clear vision for the audience.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end integrated marketing strategy for students and young adults, from audience insight and opportunity identification through execution, optimization, and learning.

  • Define the role ChatGPT can play across academic life, campus life, creative expression, and the transition from education to career.

  • Turn audience and cultural insights into clear value propositions, behavior objectives, creative strategies, channel plans, and measurement frameworks.

  • Build connected programs across campus communities, student ambassadors, creators, partnerships, activations, social, paid media, lifecycle, in-product experiences, content, and brand.

  • Develop advocacy programs that elevate credible student voices and identify emerging behaviors and cultural shifts that can inform durable strategies.

  • Partner across Product, Research, Growth, Brand, Creative, Communications, International, Education, Policy, Safety, and Legal to bring student needs into our product and marketing strategies, measure impact, and move complex programs forward.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have led integrated consumer marketing programs for students, young adults, campus communities, or a similarly distinct life stage.

  • Are equally strong as a strategist, operator, and creative thinker: you can articulate an insight and plan, bring original ideas to the table, and stand up the work required to deliver them.

  • Possess exceptional fluency in the behaviors, motivations, pressures, communities, creators, platforms, and cultural dynamics shaping students and young adults.

  • Have built programs that earned genuine participation from young audiences and understand how community, creators, partnerships, experiences, media, owned channels, and product surfaces work together.

  • Use qualitative research, behavioral data, and cultural intelligence to identify opportunities, distinguish durable shifts from passing trends, and measure outcomes.

  • Personally lead Anthropic's relationships with a portfolio of the highest-leverage AI-native startups, engaging founders, CEOs, and CTOs on multi-year commercial, technical, and partnership agreements

  • Design and negotiate novel commercial and partnership structures (credits programs, strategic pricing, co-development, joint go-to-market) that create durable, mutually beneficial relationships with breakout companies

  • Serve as the executive voice of the startup segment inside Anthropic, bringing structured customer and market insight to Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Finance and influencing roadmap and packaging decisions accordingly

  • Partner with Enterprise Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, and Customer Success leadership to define handoffs, shared accounts, and escalation paths as startups scale into enterprise customers

  • Establish the systems of record for the segment: account planning, customer health, executive business reviews, deal governance, and the metrics leadership uses to run the business

  • Represent Anthropic externally with founders, investors, and at industry events, articulating our approach to safe, frontier AI and why it matters for companies building on it

  • Lean in to support building Anthropic's presence across the startup ecosystem.

  • Have been a founder or have worked previously as a Business Development leader securing large contracts.

  • Have owned a significant revenue line with full accountability for plan, forecast, and results, and have a track record of consistently outperforming it

  • Have built or materially scaled a sales or account management organization, including designing coverage models, compensation plans, and operating rhythms

  • Bring deep, first-hand familiarity with the startup ecosystem, including relationships with founders, venture investors, and accelerators, and an instinct for identifying which early-stage companies will become the ones that matter

  • Have sold or led sales of technical, consumption-based, or platform products (APIs, infrastructure, developer tools, ML/AI), and are credible in conversations with technical founders and CTOs

  • Have structured and closed complex, non-standard commercial and partnership agreements at the executive level

  • Are a strong cross-functional leader who has influenced product, pricing, and go-to-market decisions well beyond your own organization

  • Are analytically rigorous and comfortable making decisions with imperfect data in a rapidly evolving market

  • Are motivated by Anthropic's mission and care about how frontier AI is deployed, not just how fast it grows

Strong candidates may also:

  • Have led a startups or emerging-companies segment at a cloud, infrastructure, or AI platform company through a period of hypergrowth

  • Have built ecosystem programs (startup credits, accelerator partnerships, investor programs) that meaningfully drove adoption of a developer platform

  • Have hired and developed leaders who went on to run their own organizations

  • Have experience leading through a market where the product and competitive landscape shifts quarterly

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Web & Organic, SMB Ads
description:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a Growth Marketing Manager to build the web and organic growth engine for SMB advertisers at OpenAI. This is a zero-to-one opportunity to shape how businesses discover our advertising platform, understand its value, and become successful advertisers.

You will own the SMB Ads web strategy and experimentation roadmap, combining customer insight, analytical rigor, and product judgment to grow qualified discovery and improve conversion. Your scope spans web experiences, organic search, generative engine optimization (GEO), and the journey from first visit through signup and activation. You will work closely with Product, Design, Ads Engineering, Content, and Data Science to turn opportunities into shipped experiences, operating with the speed and ownership of a startup.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the SMB Ads web strategy and roadmap to grow qualified discovery, signup, and advertiser activation.

  • Grow organic discovery through search, content, and GEO. Test new ways to help businesses find and evaluate OpenAI’s advertising offering.

  • Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to identify conversion barriers and prioritize high-impact improvements.

  • Improve the journey from website visit to signup, onboarding, and first campaign with Product and Ads Engineering.

  • Define instrumentation, test design, attribution, and reporting with Data Science and marketing systems teams to measure incremental activation and advertiser value.

  • Connect landing experiences to in-product, referral, and cross-sell acquisition programs. Coordinate onboarding and engagement with Lifecycle Marketing.

  • Use AI to accelerate research, prototyping, content, analysis, and experimentation. Scale successful tests and communicate results clearly.

  • Demonstrate ownership of web experiences and experimentation programs that improve conversion from discovery to activation.

  • Connect SEO, content-led discovery, and GEO with customer insight, web strategy, and product judgment.

  • Translate business opportunities into clear roadmaps and launched experiences with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing.

  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on growth execution. Relevant backgrounds include scaled technology businesses, startups, or consulting followed by operating experience in startup growth.

  • Evaluate and implement web capabilities with technical partners, using AI to improve execution speed and quality.

  • Understand SMB customers and bring experience in self-serve products, advertising, SaaS, marketplaces, fintech, commerce, or other high-volume digital businesses.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building web and organic growth programs for SMBs or self-serve advertising platforms.

  • Track record improving conversion from website discovery through signup and first campaign activation.

title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
description:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role

As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.

You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities.

This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing.

Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.

This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels.

  • Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities.

  • Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations.

  • Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions.

  • Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations.

  • Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation.

  • Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders.

  • Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline.

  • Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS.

  • Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys.

  • Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities.

  • Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up.

  • Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting.

  • Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity.

  • Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership.

  • Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions.

  • Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation.

  • Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion.

  • Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity.

  • Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders.

  • Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly.

Data Engineering builds and operates the trustworthy, secure, and reliable data systems that power decisions across OpenAI.
